lines.zh: 我左右摇着走，肚皮贴地一点。
lines.en: I waddle side to side, belly low.
A line of prints marks the ice.
The wind is strong; I keep my head down.
I run to the edge of the ice hole.
I am faster in water than on ice.

lines.zh: 翅膀一划，我窜出去很远。
lines.en: One stroke of my flipper carries me far.
I chase a shoal of small fish.
I catch up, then let go.

lines.zh: 再上来的时候，我靠近了。
lines.en: When I surface again, I am closer.
I stop in front of him.

lines.zh: 水从我的羽毛上淌下来。
上岸后我把水珠全抖掉了。
lines.en: Once ashore, I shake every drop of water off.

lines.zh: 我站在冰上，翅膀贴着身体。
lines.en: I stand on the ice, flippers at my sides.

lines.zh: 我转动脑袋，打量四周的冰。
lines.en: I turn my head and take in the ice around me.

lines.zh: 冰山那边太远了，我不去。
lines.en: The iceberg is too far; I am not going over there.
I do not feel it at all.

lines.zh: 我把白肚皮上的雪抖干净。
lines.en: I shake the snow off my white belly.

lines.zh: 风没停，我也没有挪地方。
lines.en: The wind keeps blowing; I keep my spot.

lines.zh: 我仰起黑背，直直地望着你。
lines.en: I arch my black back and stare straight at you.

lines.zh: 你蹲下时，我们正好平视。
lines.en: When you crouch, our eyes are level.

lines.zh: 我摇摇摆摆靠近你的靴子。
lines.en: I waddle up to your boots.
Your hand rests on the ice.
Only then do I step aside.

lines.zh: 我从鱼身上移开视线看你。
lines.en: I pull my gaze off the fish and look at you.

lines.zh: 胸口秃了一小块，风吹得发疼。
lines.en: A bald patch on my chest stings in the wind.

lines.zh: 我的鳍垂着，划水的力气没了。
lines.en: My flippers hang limp; I have no strength left to swim.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，重新撑稳身体。
lines.en: I shake my head and plant myself upright again.

lines.zh: 血珠在冰面上冻成红点。
lines.en: Beads of blood freeze into red dots on the ice.
I touch the wound with my beak.
I retreat to the ice hole.
I lower my head and swallow.

lines.zh: 鱼还没落地，我喉咙就动了。
lines.en: My throat works before the fish even lands.
This time I am less hasty.

lines.zh: 我瞥了你一眼，又盯住鱼。
lines.en: I glance at you, then my eyes snap back to the fish.

lines.zh: 脚蹼打了个滑，我才站住。
lines.en: My webbed feet slip before I find my balance.

lines.zh: 你往后让，我的脚蹼没追。
lines.en: You step back, and my webbed feet do not follow.
I touch her neck with my beak.

lines.zh: 我和她肩挨着肩站在雪里。
lines.en: She and I stand shoulder to shoulder in the snow.
Snow falls on our backs; we do not move.
The nest is a ring of stones.

lines.zh: 我把它叼在嘴里，晃了晃。
lines.en: I hold it in my beak and give it a shake.

lines.zh: 那东西顺着喉咙滑下去了。

lines.en: It is so hard my beak goes numb.
It rolls to the ice hole.
Something in the water catches it.
My body is like an arrow.

lines.zh: 它游进了我够得着的范围。
我贴着冰层，从它下方兜圈。
lines.en: I skim under the ice and circle below it.

lines.zh: 水里很暗，我的肚子是白的。
lines.en: The water is dark; my belly is white.
One beat of my flippers closes it.
I pull up in front of it.
I peck it with my beak.

lines.zh: 我把整个身子砸向它的侧腹。
lines.en: I throw my whole body against its flank.

lines.zh: 冰面上多了一小团黑和白。
lines.en: A small patch of black and white appears on the ice.

lines.zh: 雪堆裂开，我抖着站直了身。
lines.en: The snowbank splits; I shake myself upright.
One step forward, half a step sliding.
I am long used to it.
I look down at the water.

lines.zh: 火苗舔过背羽，焦味刺鼻。
lines.en: Flames lick my back feathers; the stench of singed down stings my nose.

lines.zh: 我从冰崖上掉下去，摔在雪里。
lines.en: I fall from an ice cliff into the snow.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀得滑出去很远。
lines.en: The blast slides me a long way.

lines.zh: 饿得我连冰下的藻都吃。
lines.en: Hungry enough to eat the algae under the ice.

lines.zh: 雷劈在冰上，白光刺得我闭眼。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the ice; the white flash makes me squeeze my eyes shut.
